'''Tookreek''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Kadas'sa'Nikto/Legends|Kadas'sa'Nikto]] who owned and operated [[Tookreek's Cantina]] at [[Dreviad Outpost]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Ahh... Risha's business partner, here at last. Impressive. I'm honored she felt the need to make a show of strength. She must think very highly of me.|Tookreek, to the Captain|<ref name="TOR" />}}
Tookreek worked as a [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] in the [[Diago Hixan's gang|gang]] of the reclusive [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Diago Hixan]] on the [[Desert/Legends|desert]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. He also owned a [[Tookreek's Cantina|cantina]] in [[Dreviad Outpost]].<ref name="TOR" />

Sometime by the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="MeetingDate">{{TOR_dates|1}} The events on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] for the Smuggler class take place in Act I, meaning they occurr in 3643 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]]. As Tookreek agreed to meet with the [[Voidhound]] prior to them landing on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]], it can be inferred that this agreement had been made by that [[Standard year/Legends|year]].</ref> Tookreek had agreed to meet with a [[Voidhound|smuggler]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]] at his [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]].<ref name="TOR" /> After the meeting, Tookreek agreed to take the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] captain to his boss Diago Hixan at the [[Lightspring]]. There, Tookreek and Hixan were ambushed by the [[Sith Order (Sith Empire)|Sith]] [[Vaverone Zare]] and the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Nariel Pridence]], leading to a half-crazed Hixan to call upon his [[Security droid/Legends|security droids]] to kill everyone present, including Tookreek.<ref name="TL">{{TORcite|type=class|[[Voidhound|Smuggler]]|The Lightspring|[[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]}}</ref>
